prompt: Build the half-adder: slide switch 6 and button 6 are the inputs, lights 5 and 6 show carry and sum.
note: Extras: carry (light 5) off for 1 + 0 and for 0 + 1. The procedure names only light 6 in those two steps, so light 5 wired to pushbutton 6 alone (ignoring the switch) passes the reference.

extra.cite: BK4 printed p.75 procedure = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.81; derived, not printed: slide switch LEFT (A = 1), pushbutton 6 up (B = 0), so carry out is 0 (p.74 table; p.75 light 5 = carry out)
extra.quote: Release pushbutton 6 and move slide switch 6 to the LEFT. Input A is now 1; input B is 0. Light 6 comes ON, indicating that the sum is 1: 1 + 0 = 1.

extra.cite: BK4 printed p.75 procedure = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.81; derived, not printed: slide switch RIGHT (A = 0), pushbutton 6 down (B = 1), so carry out is 0 (p.74 table; p.75 light 5 = carry out)
extra.quote: Push pushbutton 6 and hold it down. Input B is now 1. Light 6 comes ON, indicating that the sum is 1.
